claim: The TickLens npm package has zero runtime dependencies.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:zero-dependencies
sandbox: Build the publishable package, dry-run npm pack, and inspect the package that consumers install.

claim: TickLens never captures outbound payload bodies.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:payloads-never-captured
sandbox: Instrument a Socket.IO broadcast containing a sentinel payload; assert the sent packet remains intact while the snapshot and HTML report omit it.

claim: TickLens redacts room IDs by default.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:room-ids-redacted
sandbox: Record a private room ID and assert the snapshot uses one stable room label without the source ID.

claim: The 500-client sample and its exported trace name the same highest-fanout room.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:sample-export-ranking
sandbox: Open /demo, download its report, and compare the visible result and downloaded report.

claim: The demo playground does not send or save the values you enter.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:demo-playground-private
sandbox: Enter a private room label and measurements, inspect browser storage, and record every request from the demo page.

claim: A self-contained TickLens report opens offline.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:standalone-report-offline
sandbox: Open a generated report in a fresh browser context, disable network access, reload, and read the finding.

claim: TickLens does not store state payloads, player messages, or socket frames.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:outbound-content-not-stored
sandbox: Instrument a WebSocket send with a sentinel frame and assert neither snapshot nor report retains its contents.

test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:session-scoped-labels
sandbox: Record the same source room in two probes and assert each receives a redacted label that differs by session.

claim: Field Kit keeps retained traces in this browser.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:field-kit-browser-local
sandbox: Use a recorded valid license response, import a report, observe browser storage, and record outgoing requests.

claim: Field Kit saves up to 30 traces on this device.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:field-kit-thirty-traces
sandbox: Import 31 valid reports after a recorded valid license response and count the retained reports.

claim: Field Kit compares the two newest room rankings.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:field-kit-comparison
sandbox: Import two reports after a recorded valid license response and inspect the visible comparison.

claim: A Field Kit license can be restored on another device you control.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:license-other-device
sandbox: Paste one recorded valid license into two fresh browser contexts and verify the local unlock each time.

claim: Library traces remain in memory until your code exports them.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:traces-memory-until-export
sandbox: Record a trace in a new temporary directory, inspect it before export, then verify writeReport creates the requested file.

claim: The TickLens library makes no telemetry or network requests.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:library-no-telemetry
sandbox: Run probe measurement and report rendering with network access trapped, then assert no request was attempted.

claim: The documentation site updates its cached release and still reloads offline.
test: npm run build && npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:offline-update
sandbox: Install the worker on v1, update its origin to v2, reload online, disable the network, and confirm v2 reloads.
